title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: The DataFrame contains columns for distance from the bell, section number, weather, and attendance rate. Each row represents a discussion section.

title: Predictor Variables
text: Predictor variables are used to predict the outcome variable. In this case, the outcome variable is the attendance rate.

title: Adding a Predictor Variable
text: Adding a predictor variable like $$dist_{from,bell}$$ can help capture more information about the factors affecting attendance rate.

title: Model Bias
text: Model bias refers to the error introduced by approximating a real-world problem, which might be complex, by a simplified model.

title: Effect on Model Bias
text: Does adding $$dist_{from,bell}$$ as a predictor variable reduce model bias squared?
